name: Kandy Kush
summary: **Kandy Kush** is a [[kind:cultivar|hybrid]] bred by [[breeder:Reserva Privada]], a DNA Genetics line, as a cross of [[og-kush|OG Kush]] and [[trainwreck|Trainwreck]]. OG Kush contributes its resinous, earthy structure while Trainwreck adds vigorous growth and citrus notes, and the blend runs roughly three-fifths indica to two-fifths sativa. Indoors it finishes in nine to ten weeks, with outdoor harvests typically in mid-to-late October.
